answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Assigned nursery nurse licence with nursery nurses attestation flips the bet — a licence nurses renew after nursery audits — and the spiral lands on the attacker instead. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence nurses renew after nursery audits — so privacy survives, and the sable is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The canyon grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
